avis.titre: MY HOLY GRAIL OF HOLY GRAILS
avis.texte: I had a dermatologist recommend this to me 7 years ago and i have used it nearly every day since. The applicator is big and wide. This makes it easy to apply the product to your lips, however, it can make a mess when you're opening the product if you're not careful. I really like the shade on my skintone (fair with neutral undertones). I would say the coverage/color is slightly buildable. I love the smooth, shiny, and hydrated appearance it gives my lips. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because I was expecting lip oils to feel more smooth, like a lip balm, instead of tacky like a lip gloss.

avis.titre: An ok lip gloss/oil but not great

The doe foot applicator allows for easy and quick application but tends to apply too much product overall. In addition, the color I received is a bit too purple for my personal preference so I won't be wearing it often. It also doesn't last on the lips very long once applied. I wouldn't recommend this lip oil.

This lip oil is so smooth it protects my lips and gives them a very nice tint I got the ruby red and is a very nice color this makes my lips look natural yet healthy this is very handy where winters are cold and you wanna protect your lips from the environment since it hydrates the lips.

There's no sticky feel which is a big complaint I have with so many lip products, but this feels like butter. The shine is so pretty and the color is just enough of a pink flush to give you a nice natural glow.
I really loved this product. I would say it is comparable to other lip oils that are more high-end. It does not leave a sticky film or a residue after you've been wearing it for a while.

This is the first Neutrogena lip product that I try and I'm really loving it, from the hydration it provides to the beautiful coral color. I have gotten many compliments from friends and family since I started using it, the coral color really compliments me, so happy with this.

Great for a morning appointment, afternoon touch up or night out! Isn't thick or sticky , but also not runny!

I like how compact it is so it doesn't take up a lot of room and you only need a little product at a time. I think this would look gorgeous on anyone. I am going to pick up a few for my girlies as stocking stuffers this Christmas. 10/10 would recommend!

I be buy for the rest of my life. Love it so much. I told my friends and family. They said they will be buy it aging again love the color. I can't wait to buy different colors. I be buy for my mom for Christmas and ask for for Christmas too.
